lifecycleScripts.afterStart: wp-env run cli bash -c 'curl -fsSL -o /tmp/wp-cli.phar https://github.com/wp-cli/builds/raw/gh-pages/phar/wp-cli.phar && chmod +x /tmp/wp-cli.phar && sudo cp /tmp/wp-cli.phar /usr/local/bin/wp && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/wp' && wp-env run cli wp theme activate oceanwp
